description:
Move the suite profiler's self-test out of the default suite into a declared gate over the script.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/scratch_build/build_profile_policy_tests.rs:332-345` (`test_profile_test_suite_script_passes_its_own_self_test`) runs `scripts/profile-test-suite.sh --self-test` inside the default suite. The gate that runs it was registered in `.jit/gates.toml` at planning.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The registered gate `profile-suite-selftest` runs `scripts/profile-test-suite.sh --self-test`, and its `[gates.inputs]` cover the self-test, the script it exercises and that script's fixtures; its declaration in `.jit/gates.toml` carries `mode` with no `auto` key.
- [hard] REQ-02: `profile-suite-selftest` fails whenever the self-test exits non-zero, including exit 2 for a missing tool, and passes on the tree with this change.
- [hard] REQ-03: No test in the default suite runs the profiler's self-test.
title: Suite-profiler self-test runs as a declared gate
